overview_description.description: Cuboh is a developer of an application intended to automate online food orders for restaurants. The company's platform helps to use several delivery platforms like Doordash, Postmates, UberEats and more by bringing them all to one system and integrating it with POS systems, enabling restaurants to manage all online orders on just one easy-to-use interface, easily add new apps and expand to new markets.

about_short_description.short_description: Cuboh is a developer of an application intended to automate online food orders for restaurants.

product.name: Tablet Consolidation
product.description: A system that consolidates orders from multiple third-party delivery apps into a single tablet interface for easier management.

product.name: POS Integrations
product.description: Integration of third-party delivery app orders directly with a restaurant's Point of Sale system to reduce errors and improve order accuracy.

product.name: Menu Management
product.description: A centralized platform to manage and update menus across multiple third-party delivery apps simultaneously.

product.name: Direct Online Ordering System
product.description: A commission-free online ordering system that enables restaurants to accept orders directly from customers without relying on third-party delivery apps.

product.name: Customer Support
product.description: Customer service providing timely assistance and support for Cuboh users, available daily with rapid response times.
